{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Cream silk blouse, tailored boxy fit, knee-length tunic cut, soft off-white (#f5f5dc), smooth woven fabric.
Charcoal wool-blend wide-leg trousers, straight leg with slight taper below the knee, deep grey (#36454f), heavy drape material.
Oxford white leather sneakers, classic low-top silhouette, crisp white (#ffffff), soft nubuck leather.

This outfit works perfectly for a professional autumn day at the office by balancing comfort and polish. The cream blouse adds warmth against the cool grey trousers, creating a sophisticated neutral palette that flatters her complexion. As the weather is mild daylight conditions allow for omitting an outer layer while the structured wool pants ensure she stays warm enough without overheating. This neat casual combination respects the workplace dress code while accommodating her desire for effortless yet refined styling."}
